title: Text: DET Jerry Lewis ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Feeling good now. On my way to see my grandchildren in London yes England.  Early sign ups for 2020 camp over 90. Thank you again for that great article. JL
Wow! Sorry I missed you yesterday. Deadline for last year’s rate pass yet?
No it’s tomorrow. Might hit 100 early. Unreal!!! Thanks again.  See you April 4th. Have your article framed and ready to go in my office
Absolutely, I will send a tweet out. Have a safe trip and fun! Enjoy
Yep. Back Wed. Travel north safely
